claims.text:
behaviour-cloning-drift

**Identity / target / source:** `ai:behaviour-cloning-drift` → `ai-behaviour-cloning-drift` → `src/demos/ai/ai-behaviour-cloning-drift`; source `company/domains/proposals/2026-10-18-ai-map-expansion.json#concepts/113`; brief `company/domains/briefs/2026-10-19-ai-next30e.md#12-behaviour-cloning-drift`. **Packet:** R2. **Level / prerequisites:** core; `ai:mdp-basics`, `ai:distribution-shift`.

**Nearest / distinct payoff:** distribution-shift contrasts external distributions; this learner’s own wrong action changes which states its later policy receives.

**Computed primary model:** States(t,lane), t=0..3, lane0(center) or1(right). Expert demonstrations only(0,0),(1,0),(2,0) with Advance. Advance increments t, keeps lane; Right increments t and sets lane1; Correct increments t and sets lane0. Lookup imitation defaults unseen states to Advance. Original rollout stays lane0 and reaches goal at t3/lane0. Force one imitation error Right at t0: visited states(1,1),(2,1) are outside demonstrations, defaultAdvance keeps lane1, terminal goal missed.

**Countercase / boundary:** One initial action error causes two unsupported subsequent decisions under this model, not independent new mistakes. The new states are outside the demonstration set, not inherently impossible to control. If the evaluation starts at lane1, even a perfect fit on demonstrated center states says nothing about that initial state.

**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict the state after the first wrongRight; recall how expert-state accuracy can remain100% while the slipped rollout fails.

**Intervention / retained witness:** Advance one transition then Force slip restarts the identical episode with the single declared error. Highlight each visited state’s demonstration membership and action. Retain expert and slipped traces through Reset. Correct action is visible in the transition rule but not silently inserted by the learner.

**Source obligation:** [Ross–Gordon–Bagnell original DAgger PDF](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v15/ross11a/ross11a.pdf), opened2026-10-19, §2.1 expert-state supervision, §3 dataset aggregation/Algorithm3.1. The local finite state lookup/forced slip is not the paper’s driving benchmark or a claim of a universal recovery guarantee.
